locomotion.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted 2D tactical RPG animation sprite sheet. Match the supplied knight's painted ink-edged detailed materials, muted warm highlights, proportionate anatomy and reasonable boots, visible gloves. Orthographic shallow elevated tactical camera ~18 degrees, facing front-right three-quarter in EVERY cell, camera fixed. Same identity and clothing throughout, no perspective drift. True transparent background, NO floor, NO labels, NO shadows, NO colored fringe. Full body in every cell. Exact 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen separate non-overlapping equal-sized cells, generous empty space around every figure. Body height 220 pixels or more; large square output. Do not crop feet, weapon or head. An adult broad-shouldered human raider with a weathered face visible below a dark umber cloth hood, short stubble, dirty ochre brown quilted tunic and patchwork dark leather shoulder armor with small iron plates, dark charcoal trousers, worn but proportional leather boots and leather gloves. He holds one practical iron bearded battle axe on a long brown haft in his RIGHT hand, LEFT hand free for balance. No horns, no fantasy oversized axe, no sword, no shield. The axe has one edge and a compact metal head. Exact row-major layout: row1 two calm neutral idles weapon carried safely downward, then two combat ready guards. Rows2-3 eight sequential frames of ONE natural relaxed WALK cycle, modest alternating left/right heel contact and passing foot with real knee flexion, no wide-legged stomping. Row4 four subtle COMBAT READY idle frames, axe held diagonally across his front ready for a proper shoulder-led cut. Keep same front-right3/4 camera and consistent body height everywhere; give spear/axe sufficient empty room.
